inputs.goal: summarize the H1 2026 cycle for a senior engineer on the infra team

Quarterly sprint retrospectives indicated a 20% reduction in incident response time and 12% increase in deployment frequency following the implementation of continuous integration improvements. The infrastructure team successfully migrated 30% of legacy systems to containerized environments, contributing to overall system stability and reduced operational overhead.
